grisk: <High nasal kobold rasp, quick and greedy; fear catches under each order. Mood: angry.> That was my good side!
<long pause>
grisk: <High nasal kobold rasp, quick and greedy; fear catches under each order. Mood: sad.> The market pays! I’ll split it!
<long pause>
grisk: <High nasal kobold rasp, quick and greedy; fear catches under each order. Mood: angry.> Up! I counted you in the wages!
<long pause>
grisk: <High nasal kobold rasp, quick and greedy; fear catches under each order. Mood: angry.> Dig faster!
<long pause>
grisk: <High nasal kobold rasp, quick and greedy; fear catches under each order. Mood: sad.> Tell them… I kept the tally.
<long pause>
old_maud: <Ancient, papery, unhurried; lucid concern under the cackle. No grand revelation. Mood: sad.> The boy is by my fire. Let his father know. As for that old bear… hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.
<long pause>
old_maud: <Ancient, papery, unhurried; a small grief, without explaining its cause. Mood: sad.> Poor old thing. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. No, dearie. Keep the claw. There is nothing else down there to carry home.
